# OHSE

> > OHSE is a comprehensive occupational health, safety, and environment education and certification platform offering free courses, training resources, and credential verification.

OHSE.ca provides occupational health and safety education, professional certifications (OHSC), and a video library covering workplace safety topics. The platform serves safety professionals, supervisors, and organizations seeking to improve workplace standards and compliance.

## Key Topics

- Occupational Health and Safety
- Workplace Safety
- OHSC Certification
- Environmental Protection
- Heat Stress Prevention
- Safety Audits
- Supervisor Wellness
- Hot Work Environments
- OHSA Compliance
- Certificate Verification
- Thermal Conditions
- Hazard Assessment
- Free Courses
- OHS Education

## Core Platform

- [OHSE Homepage](https://ohse.ca): OHSE homepage defining occupational health, safety, and environment standards and mission
- [About OHSE](https://ohse.ca/about-us): OHSE.ca mission, free courses, certifications, and workplace safety education overview

## Certification & Exams

- [OHSC Exam Platform](https://exam.ohse.ca): OHSC exam results and certificate verification platform for certified professionals

## Learning Resources

- [Video Library](https://ohse.ca/videos): Video library covering safety audits, training, hazard assessment, and workplace safety topics

## Community & Partnerships

- [Guest Posts](https://ohse.ca/guest-posts): Sponsored guest post program for safety brands and consultants to share expertise
